results.text: That was an even, fast shot: 18 g in, 36 g out in a measured 16 seconds from button start. With sourness and no channeling, I’d make one small move finer on the Barista Express built-in grinder, keeping dose and yield unchanged, then reassess sweetness and drying. Don’t chase 25–30 seconds as a pass/fail rule—the goal is a slower, sweeter extraction.
